answer: A quadratic slashing primitive locks collateral so each Sybil sparrow pays cost C_i = k n_i^2, while zero-knowledge verifiable delay enforces one sable identity per proof and prism attestations make forgery negligible. If extracted value is v_i, marginal cost dC/dn_i = 2k n_i exceeds v_i once n_i > v_i/(2k), making expected utility negative. The aggregate attack threshold therefore sits above the protocol's bonded capital, sustaining a robust Nash equilibrium where honest staking dominates.
